paragraphs.text: Sokenzan (soh-KEHN-zahn; Japanese: 霜 剣 山 ; rōmaji : Sōkenzan ; literally: "Frost-Sword Mountains") is Kamigawa 's largest mountain range.

The Sokenzan mountain range is the largest in Kamigawa, and it lies south of Eiganjo . Cunning Akki live here, among bandits, yamabushi shamans , as well as ronin (masterless samurai ), which were ruled by the bandit king Godo during the Kami War . Deep in the Sokenzan mountain range lay the Tendo Peaks , the steepest mountains in Kamigawa. The Heart of Frost, one of the Tendo Peaks , was haunted for some time by a Yuki-onna , while Untaidake , the tallest mountain on the plane, was guarded by the yamabushi Ryusaki Kumano . The Sokenzan is guarded by the dragon kami Ryusei , the Falling Star.

Shinka , the Bloodsoaked Keep, is located within the range. There Hidetsugu and his o-bakemono practised the summoning of oni . The foothills of the Sokenzan border Takenuma to the northwest, and Towabara and Jukai to the north.
The Sokenzan became the center for the Asari Uprisers , a rebel organization desiring freedom from Imperial tyranny.
Ganzan Pass (GAHN-zahn) - a treacherous pass through the Sokenzan Range; means "rock-cut".
Gods' Eye - a tower where contact between the spirit and material worlds is possible.
Johyo Glacier — a glacier between the Tendo Peaks and the Heart of Frost
Shinka Keep - an ogre-mage hermitage located within a two-day walk from the edge of the Jukai .
Sokenzanshi - a hardy, self-reliant city built right into the sides of the mountains. An industrious and artistic city with geothermal springs.

Tendo Peaks -the impossibly steep, spire-like mountains in the heart of the Sokenzan Range. Untaidake - the tallest mountain in Kamigawa Heart of Frost - another mountain on the cold western edge of the range, most of a day's walk from the Takenuma border.
